suitable for WhatsApp Business or equivalent business messaging
no requirement to expose owner's existing SSM-recorded telephone

phone.selection_rule: Choose the lowest-friction business-registered line with acceptable Labuan coverage, no unnecessary device contract, and clear business-account evidence. Coverage/availability must be confirmed at registration time.

address.goal: Obtain a separate lawful public business/correspondence address without exposing the owner's residential-overlapping SSM address.
must_have: provider confirms in writing the exact permitted use of the address
physical location exists and mail can be received
not represented as a private office unless the service legitimately provides one
acceptable for LD's intended public disclosure purpose
if used as a changed principal place of business, SSM change process is completed within the applicable 30-day period
mandatory_questions_before_purchase: Can this exact address lawfully be used by a Malaysian sole proprietorship as its public trade/business correspondence address?
Can it be used as the SSM principal place of business if LD decides to change that registered address?
Will the provider issue a service agreement or letter confirming LD's right to use the address?
Is mail/registered mail accepted and how is receipt evidenced?
Are there restrictions on displaying the address on website, invoices, quotations, receipts and marketplace profiles?
Is the facility a real physical business centre and what office/coworking access is included?
What is the monthly fee, deposit, setup fee, minimum term and cancellation rule?
address.rule: Do not treat a virtual-office marketing claim as sufficient legal evidence. Validate permitted use before relying on the address.
